Safe.summary: Low thermal stress. Normal outdoor activity safe.
advisory: Normal outdoor activities are safe for all groups.
Maintain baseline hydration during extended exposure.

Moderate Heat Stress.summary: Moderate thermal stress. Caution for unacclimatized individuals.
advisory: Limit continuous high-intensity work or sports to 45 minutes.
Schedule regular water breaks in shaded zones.
Monitor outdoor physical workers and vulnerable populations.

High Heat Stress.summary: High thermal stress. Danger of heat exhaustion with prolonged exposure.
advisory: Limit outdoor strenuous exertion to 30 minutes per hour.
Mandate shade resting periods and active fluid intake.
Avoid concrete quads and unshaded transit paths during peak hours.

Extreme Heat Stress.summary: Extreme thermal stress. High risk of heat stroke during peak exposure.
advisory: Cancel or reschedule non-essential outdoor physical activity.
Rest breaks must equal or exceed work duration in air-conditioned spaces.
Immediate heat-illness protocol required for outdoor personnel.
